Unlocks three free actions usable when you spend a Mythic Point to Manifest your Realm — actions resolved at the table, no self statistic changes.
A Deception disguise/identity option; the GM adjudicates who detects you and against which DC. Nothing on the sheet changes.
Duplicate record of Many Guises — same GM-adjudicated disguise identity, no statistic change.

'You have familiarity with harpoons and tridents, treating them as simple weapons for the purposes of proficiency' is a real proficiency grant with no FEAT_LANE_GRANTS entry. Both weapon ids verified in core.json (harpoon, trident — both martial). The 5th-level critical specialization rider is deliberately NOT written: the feat is taken at 4th and critSpec carries no level gate, so writing it would over-grant for a level; the underwater range-increment clause is GM-side terrain handling.
A 2-action Swim activity resolved at the table; grants no Speed and no statistic.
Imbues a worn ikon with a Transcendence activity resolved at the table (the imported text is truncated after the activity header); no immanence bonus to any of your own statistics.
A difficult-terrain exception when you Step plus a degree-of-success upgrade and an off-guard exception while Balancing — situational rulings with no numeric bonus the sheet can carry.

'The damage die for your fist unarmed attacks becomes 1d6 instead of 1d4' is a real Strike change and nothing delivers it. The lane is a HARD-CODED list: derive.ts ~1692 `fistDieUpgraded = ownedFeatureIds(...).has('powerful-fist') || heritage warrior-automaton/warrior-jotunborn`. Martial Artist must be added there — but unlike Powerful Fist it does NOT drop the nonlethal trait (it only removes the -2 lethal-attack penalty), so the existing branch can't be reused verbatim. grantedStrikes is wrong here: it would add a SECOND 'Fist' row beside the d4 baseline rather than upgrading it.
Extends the duration of an active composition cantrip by 1 round when you damage an enemy — in-play duration tracking, no statistic change.
A spellshape action that trades your own HP for an ALLY's healing; resolved at the table.
A free action that removes the frightened condition and destroys your warmask — in-encounter condition handling.
Widens Fabricate Truth to all enemies in 30 feet; changes only the targets' side of the check.

Raises your advanced alchemy LEVEL (the item-level ceiling), not the item count. The app's Advanced Alchemy panel already offers every alchemical item of level <= your character level (AlchemyPanel.tsx:37) and models no level ceiling at all, so this grant is already available; the `advancedAlchemy` field is an item COUNT ({items,addInt,atLevel}) and would be the wrong semantic.

Delivered by CASTER_ARCHETYPES in src/rules/casterArchetypes.ts — 'animist-dedication' derives masterId 'master-animist-spellcasting' (mk(), line ~141), which unlocks 7th/8th-rank slots at levels 18/20 and raises spell proficiency to master.
CASTER_ARCHETYPES 'bard-dedication' masterId = 'master-bard-spellcasting' (casterArchetypes.ts) — slots + master spell proficiency.
CASTER_ARCHETYPES 'beast-gunner-dedication' masterId = 'master-beast-gunner-spellcasting' — slots + master spell proficiency.

Cathartic Mage Dedication carries spellcastingGrant {occult, cha, trained} + a cantrip pick, but basic/expert/master-cathartic-spellcasting carry nothing and 'cathartic-mage-dedication' is absent from CASTER_ARCHETYPES, so the master feat delivers nothing. The proficiency half IS expressible now (spellcastingGrant takes the best rank per tradition, build.ts:2714); the 7th/8th-rank slot progression still needs a CASTER_ARCHETYPES entry for the archetype.

Widens the TRIGGER of bonuses already shown on the sheet — FEAT_SITUATIONAL carries 'monster-hunter' (+1 circumstance attack) and 'monster-warden' (situationalBonuses.ts:501,503) — from critical success to success, and lets Nature identify any creature (a Recall Knowledge ruling). A second situational entry would duplicate the same starred bonus.
A downtime Aid rule for Craft/Earn Income; the app models neither activity's check.

'You gain Medusa's Wrath, Touch of Death, or another 8th-rank qi spell you have access to' is a PICK that grants a focus spell, and the record carries no effectChoices. Qi spells are focus spells with the monk trait (medusas-wrath and touch-of-death are both rank 8, traits focus+monk in core.json), so an open spellFilter covers the printed options and any other 8th-rank qi spell. Modelled on perfect-ki-adept, which already uses effectChoices for the same lane. No focusPoolBonus is written: build.ts:1609 notes each granted focus spell already carries its own pool point.

effectChoices.prompt: Choose an 8th-rank qi spell (Medusa's Wrath, Touch of Death, or another you have access to)

records.reason: Basic Red Mantis Magic carries spellcastingGrant {divine, cha, trained} + two cantrip picks, but master-red-mantis-magic carries nothing and 'red-mantis-assassin-dedication' is not in CASTER_ARCHETYPES, so 'the master spellcasting benefits' deliver nothing. spellcastingGrant raises the spell attack/DC proficiency to master (best rank per tradition wins, build.ts:2714); the ranked-slot half still needs a CASTER_ARCHETYPES entry.
CASTER_ARCHETYPES 'rivethun-involutionist-dedication' (slug 'rivethun') masterId = 'master-rivethun-spellcasting'.

'Add a single scroll with a 6th-rank spell (7th at 20th level)' to your daily scrolls is a real free consumable the player picks each day, and no lane exists: nothing in src/rules references scroll caches, and Basic/Expert Scroll Cache are equally inert. What is missing is a daily-preparations GRANTED-CONSUMABLE lane (a scroll of a chosen spell at a fixed rank, refreshed daily) — dailyChoices.ts only records a pick, it cannot mint an item.
Permanent quickened whose extra action can only Aim or Launch a siege weapon — action economy in an encounter, not a sheet statistic.

First Frost carries spellcastingGrant {arcane, cha, trained}; snowcaster/expert-snowcasting/master-snowcasting carry nothing and the gelid shard archetype is absent from CASTER_ARCHETYPES, so 'you gain the benefits' delivers nothing. Master proficiency in arcane spell attacks/DCs is expressible now; the new spell ranks still need a CASTER_ARCHETYPES entry for the archetype.
CASTER_ARCHETYPES 'sorcerer-dedication' masterId = 'master-sorcerer-spellcasting'.

A Pervasive Magic VARIANT-RULE feat that restates the generic spellcasting-archetype benefit ('you gain the archetype benefits'); the app already delivers that progression through each archetype's own Master X Spellcasting feat, and the variant rule itself is not one of the modelled optional rules.

'During daily preparations, designate one spell slot to become TWO summoning slots of the same rank' is a real net gain of a spell slot, chosen daily and restricted to summoning/incarnate spells. No lane: spellSlotBonus can only ADD slots (perRank/byRank) with no rank choice, no slot consumed, and no restriction on what can be prepared in them; dailyChoices.ts records a morning pick but cannot alter the slot table. Needs a restricted-slot / slot-conversion lane.

CASTER_ARCHETYPES 'summoner-dedication' derives masterId 'master-summoner-spellcasting' via mk() (casterArchetypes.ts:141), so taking this id unlocks the master tier — despite the file comment claiming no such feat exists.

This is a SECOND record of the same Secrets of Magic feat (the class-category sibling of basic-/expert-summoner-spellcasting). CASTER_ARCHETYPES only recognises the id 'master-summoner-spellcasting', so a player who picks this one gets no 7th/8th-rank slots and no master spell proficiency. Needs an id-alias for the master tier in casterArchetypes.ts (or the duplicate suppressed); a spellcastingGrant here would be wrong, since the summoner archetype's casting is a real slot caster, not the innate profile.
CASTER_ARCHETYPES 'witch-dedication' masterId = 'master-witch-spellcasting'.
CASTER_ARCHETYPES 'wizard-dedication' masterId = 'master-wizard-spellcasting'.

Makes the identified CREATURE off-guard against you; the effect lands entirely on the target's side.
A reaction that spends a slot to counteract another creature's spell — resolved at the table against the triggering caster.

'Your animal companion becomes a mature animal companion' is exactly the COMPANION_MODS maturityFloor lane (companionGrants.ts:140), and no key exists for it — the companion stays at the builder's default 'young' unless the player changes the dropdown by hand.

companionMod.note: Mature Animal Companion: your companion is at least a mature animal companion. During an encounter, even if you don't Command an Animal, it can still use 1 action on your turn to Strike or Stride (or Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim if it has that Speed) — if it does, that's all it gets that round.
